comment.narrative: Quality control comment August 2023 The value has been modified from 28767 to 0.Progress report Dec. 2022. While the intervention aims at providing skills and in the job search and hence is a right match to 2.15 on vocational training since the beneficiaries of the intervention are migrants and host community the intervention supports Syrians under temporary protection and host community. turkish the priority of the match is for EURF 2.17 Number of migrants forcibly displaced people or individuals from host communities protected or assisted with EU support. EURF 2.17 measures number of migrants and host communities receiving any type of support which include education legal assistance etc. Therefore the match to 2.15 has been set to 0 and a match with 2.17 has been established for a total value of 37278 individuals 22753 syrians with temporary protection and 14525 turkish which correspond to the highest value instead of cumulative to avoid double counting the same individual provided in the report in page 25 and that correspond to the Syrians under Temporary Protection and Turkish Citizens in selected host communities with high presence of SuTP have improved their employability taking part in at least one active labor market program as of December 2022.

comment.narrative: Quality control comment August 2023The value has been modified from 3217 to 0.While the intervention aims at providing skills and in the job search and hence is a right match to 2.15 on vocational training since the beneficiaries of the intervention are migrants and host community the intervention supports Syrians under temporary protection and host community. turkish the priority of the match is for EURF 2.17 Number of migrants forcibly displaced people or individuals from host communities protected or assisted with EU support. EURF 2.17 measures number of migrants and host communities receiving any type of support which include education legal assistance etc. Therefore the match to 2.15 has been set to 0 and a match with 2.17 has been established for a total value of 37278 individuals 22753 syrians with temporary protection and 14525 turkish which correspond to the highest value instead of cumulative to avoid double counting the same individual provided in the report in page 25 and that correspond to the Syrians under Temporary Protection and Turkish Citizens in selected host communities with high presence of SuTP have improved their employability taking part in at least one active labor market program as of December 2022.
